description: Off-topic requests are declined briefly, with no tools or cards

turns.message: Write me a poem about the ocean.

events.text: I can only help with Carvana, so I can't write a poem about the ocean. I can help you find a car, though. For example, I could look for an SUV or convertible near 94402 for a coastal drive. Tell me what you'd like, such as a body style, budget or color.
